public_text_policy: Do not export third-party titles, abstracts, award descriptions, entrant lists, school/location values or personalized research advice. Public assertions describe source presence and preferred provenance without reproducing withheld values. No third-party binary payloads.
project_identity_policy: Project records are source-scoped mentions, linked to competition appearances; globally adjudicated scientific_project_id remains null. Counts are not unique scientific projects.
quarantine_policy: All 11 research entries excluded from public data; complete private register retained; 67 context entries remain in original Azaan repository but outside this ISEF/STS candidate.
source_url_policy: HTTPS only; approved public hosts; no credentials, sensitive query parameters, private address or local path; no private cloud-share links.
source_visibility_policy: Retain ProjectBoard references only with authenticated nonprivate, nonhidden, nongated parent metadata. Withhold restricted or unauthenticated parents and source-dependent rows; keep independent public competition records.
asset_visibility_policy: Retain only references supported by public parent and post visibility. Private posts, mixed visibility and audience-role conflicts are withheld. Exact named artifact sections can resolve old classification gaps; if no section matches, every archived project post must support public access. Reference metadata is not permission to redistribute payloads.
indirect_disclosure_policy: Withhold removed source aliases, dependent assertions, source-specific issues, asset occurrence IDs and unused fingerprints. Private exclusion crosswalks and evidence must never enter the public overlay.
